**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## UI Parity Geometry & Styling Requirements

- [ ] CHK001 - Is the expanded width requirement explicitly defined as exactly 256px? [Completeness, Spec §VR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the collapsed width requirement explicitly defined as exactly 80px? [Completeness, Spec §VR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are expanded padding and spacing requirements explicitly matched to Figma 1:986? [Consistency, Spec §VR-001]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is the collapsed navigation item geometry explicitly defined as 48x48px squares? [Completeness, Plan]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are active and inactive state colors explicitly documented for both desktop states? [Completeness, Spec §VR-003]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is the updated border radius (4px) explicitly defined for nav links? [Clarity, Plan]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are footer border opacity (0.2) and padding requirements documented for exact parity? [Completeness, Plan]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the inverted collapse toggle orientation correctly documented for the collapsed state? [Consistency, Plan]
